label: input b/f at original positions 4+ in sequences starting with m/x/t
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate neuron that fires only during the original (input) phase, almost exclusively when the input token is b or f (~97% of mass), mostly at original positions 4-6 (none at t<3), and strongly gated by the first token of the sequence being m, x or t (~90% of mass). Never fires on the delimiter or copy phase. The predicate captures ~85% of activation mass but precision is low (~18%): most b/f inputs at t>=4 in m/x/t-initial sequences do not cross threshold, and no simple extra condition on earlier tokens (prior b/f, digits, repeated m/x/t) cleanly separates them, suggesting a graded hidden-state dependence. Highest activations are on b/f at t=4-6; rare weak firings on n, 0, s, r, j.
